title: Tutu de Feijão
description: Tutu de Feijão is a dish from Brazil featuring black beans, yellow onion, garlic, bacon. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used.

steps.instruction: Soak the dried beans in ample clean cold water for about 400 minutes, drain and discard the soaking water; cook fully in fresh water.
Cook the listed ingredients in simmering water for about 100 minutes until tender; drain well if necessary.
Chop the vegetables as needed. Sauté the listed ingredients over medium heat, stirring, for about 9 minutes until softened and aromatic.
Drain the cooked ingredients and pound or mash while warm for about 12 minutes until thick, elastic and smooth; shape into portions with wet hands or a spoon.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
